title: Voluntary Surrender of Certificate of Registration by NBFCs (including HFCs) for Cancellation – Application Form and Indicative Checklist
description: The Reserve Bank, vide press release dated September 23, 2025 on Voluntary surrender of Certificate of Registration (CoR) by NBFCs (including HFCs) for Cancellation, had announced about the availability of the application form and indicative checklist for voluntary surrender of CoR on the PRAVAAH portal. 2.
